questions.q: In an odd-one-out list, which item does NOT belong with the others?
questions.solution: Virus, trojan, worm are **malware (attacks)**; a firewall is **protection** — the odd one out.

questions.q: The default file extension of an Excel 2007 or later workbook is —
questions.solution: **.xlsx** is the Office Open XML default (X = XML); .xls is the 97-2003 file.

questions.q: At which layer of the OSI model does a switch primarily operate?
questions.solution: Switches forward frames using MAC (hardware) addresses, which belong to the Data Link layer (2). Routers use IP at layer 3.
questions.shortcut: MAC-address device = layer 2; IP device = layer 3.

questions.q: Deleting a file with Shift+Delete in Windows Explorer:
options: Deletes it permanently without moving it to Recycle Bin
questions.solution: Shift+Delete bypasses the Recycle Bin and permanently deletes the file (after confirmation). Plain Delete sends it to the Recycle Bin.
questions.shortcut: Add Shift = skip the bin. That single fact answers most Recycle-Bin questions.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best completes the paragraph.

Film tickets in the multiplexes now cost a family of four more than a full month of a streaming subscription, and the popcorn is extra.
options: When an outing costs a month of home viewing, the sofa wins.
Cinemas should screen more regional films.
OTT platforms raise prices every year too.
questions.solution: The paragraph sets up the price comparison; option 1 lands the implied conclusion. Option 3 argues back instead of completing; the rest drift.

questions.q: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.  He has been working in this office ___ five years.
questions.solution: A length of time takes **for**; since needs a starting point (since 2021).

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To face the music
options: to accept the unpleasant results of one's own actions
questions.solution: *Face the music* = to accept criticism or punishment for what one has done. The concert and loud-music options are literal; 'run away from punishment' is the opposite.
questions.shortcut: Kill the two music options; the opposite is the last trap.

questions.q:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Mother often says, "Honesty is the best policy."
options: Mother often says that honesty was the best policy.
Mother often said that honesty is the best policy.
Mother often says that honesty is the better policy.
Mother often says that honesty is the best policy.
questions.solution: Present frame **says** keeps the quote in the present: **is the best policy** — doubly safe because the sentence is also a universal truth. 'Was the best policy' backshifts twice wrongly; 'often said' moves the reporting verb; 'the better policy' corrupts the superlative.
questions.shortcut: Present frame + universal truth = nothing shifts.

questions.q: Fossils of plants and animals are found only in which type of rock?
questions.solution: Only **sedimentary rocks** form in layers at the surface, where living remains can be buried; heat and pressure in other rocks destroy them.

questions.q:
Consider the statements:
1. The Vernacular Press Act was passed in 1878.
2. The Delhi Durbar of 1877 proclaimed Victoria 'Empress of India'.
3. The Arms Act of Lytton's time disarmed Indians.
Which are correct?
questions.solution: All three belong to **Lytton's** tenure (1876–80): the press gag (1878), the 1877 Durbar, and the Arms Act.
questions.shortcut: Lytton's trio: press gag, Arms Act, Durbar.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution is called its '**heart and soul**' by Dr B.R. Ambedkar?
questions.solution: **Article 32** (right to constitutional remedies) — Ambedkar's phrase, because without the writ power the other rights would be declarations only.

questions.q: The President of India is elected by —
options: An electoral college of elected MPs and elected MLAs
questions.solution: The electoral college has **elected MPs**, **elected MLAs of the states**, and (since the 70th Amendment) elected MLAs of **Delhi and Puducherry**. Voting is by proportional representation, single transferable vote.
questions.shortcut: Elected MPs + elected MLAs (states, Delhi, Puducherry).

questions.q: The average of 30 results was 20. It was later found that a result of 24 had been wrongly recorded as 21. The corrected average is:
questions.solution: Error $= +3$: corrected mean $= \frac{600+3}{30} = 20.1$.

questions.q: For what value of $k$ will the system $2x+ky=5$ and $4x+6y=12$ have no solution?
questions.solution: No solution needs $\frac{a_1}{a_2}=\frac{b_1}{b_2}\ne\frac{c_1}{c_2}$: $\frac24=\frac k6=\frac12$ → $k=3$, and $\frac{5}{12}\ne\frac12$ confirms the lines are distinct.

questions.q: Three successive discounts of 10%, 20% and 25% are equivalent to a single discount of:
questions.solution: Kept: $0.9 \times 0.8 \times 0.75 = 0.54$ → single discount $= 100 - 54 = 46\%$.

questions.q: The area of a sector of a circle of radius $14$ cm with central angle $90^\circ$ is (take $\pi = 22/7$):
questions.solution: $\frac{90}{360} = \frac14$: sector $= \frac14 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 196 = \frac14 \times 616 = 154$ sq cm.

questions.q:
Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and one is different. Find the odd one out.

**Potato, Carrot, Radish, Tomato**
questions.solution: Potato, carrot and radish are parts that **grow under the ground**. A tomato grows **above the ground** on the plant → **Tomato**.

questions.q:
**Statement:** The railway has decided to run a special train between Delhi and Patna during the Chhath festival.

**Assumptions:**
I. Many people will want to travel between Delhi and Patna during the festival.
II. The railway has enough coaches and staff to run one more train.

Which of the assumptions is/are implicit in the statement?
options: Neither I nor II is implicit
Both I and II are implicit
questions.solution: Negate I: no extra travellers — the special train is pointless, so I is **implicit**. Negate II: the railway cannot run another train — the decision cannot be carried out, so II is **implicit**. Answer: **both**.
questions.shortcut: A decision assumes a need (demand) and feasibility (resources).

questions.q: In a mirror, a wall clock appears to show **11:20**. What is the actual time?
questions.solution: Actual time + image time = 12:00, so the answer is 11:60 − 11:20 = **12:40**. Check: 11:20 + 12:40 = 12:00.
